- If sentiment is consistently low (≤0.3) in recent days, model tends to overestimate; reduce forecast by 1–2%.
- If sentiment is high (≥0.7) and price is rising, model often overshoots; cap upward revisions at +3% of recent 7-day avg.
- If model shows sharp upward spike followed by 3+ days of high sentiment, expect mean reversion; reduce forecast 1–2% for next 3 days.
- If model forecast is below true outcome by >5% for 3+ consecutive days, adjust upward by 1–2% per day until convergence.
- If sentiment is volatile (fluctuating >0.25) and model is flat, expect price to move; add 0.5–1% momentum bias toward recent sentiment direction.
- For 30-day horizon, if model is consistently 2–4% above true outcome, apply downward bias of 1–2% for next 5 days.
